annotations.title: Rent points estimate for a Dutch home (paid)

description: Use when a tenant asks if their Dutch rent is too high or what the maximum rent is: estimated rent points (WWS) from floor area, energy label and neighbourhood WOZ, the likely segment (social up to 143 points, middle 144-186, free 187+) and the approximate maximum basic rent (2026 limits). An estimate with a link to the official check. Input: postcode + house number. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'
